blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Generative models are transforming Bayesian computational imaging, yet the field still lacks physics-aware foundation models. Current practice falls into two camps. Large foundation image models are deployed as plug-and-play priors with zero-shot approximate likelihood guidance, which introduces significant bias and computational cost. Physics-aware generative models avoid this bias, but each is tied to a specific dataset, task and instrument. We introduce BAM (Bayesian Anything Model), a lightweight foundation model for few-step, physics-aware posterior sampling that generalises robustly to unseen data and tasks, zero-shot or with minimal finetuning. BAM upgrades the operator-conditioned Reconstruct Anything Model (RAM) backbone ( Terris et al., 2026 ) into a conditional flow map, so instrument physics is specified at inference time rather than fixed during training. BAM has just 36M parameters and is pre-trained jointly on large image corpora and libraries of forward operators. A single network then draws posterior samples in a few steps, with no likelihood approximation and no guidance weights to tune. Across linear inverse problems on FFHQ, AFHQ, LSUN, DIV2K and the Köhler camera-shake benchmark, BAM outperforms in just 3 3 steps both specialised models and leading zero-shot methods in sample quality, at a fraction of their computational cost. BAM gives the community an accessible entry point to generative computational imaging, lowers the economic and environmental cost of training imaging models, and opens a new path for research on physics-aware Bayesian computational imaging. Official page: https://bayesian-anything-model.github.io/

blocks.en:
State-of-the-art Bayesian imaging methods learn from representative data via plug-and-play (PnP) or end-to-end strategies. PnP methods plug a pre-trained denoiser or generative prior into an iterative scheme that enforces the likelihood ( Venkatakrishnan et al., 2013 ; Romano et al., 2017 ; Kamilov et al., 2023 ) , and zero-shot posterior samplers extend this idea beyond point
estimates ( Laumont et al., 2022 ; Kawar et al., 2022 ; Chung et al., 2023 ) . With modern diffusion model (DM) priors ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Song et al., 2021 ) , this flexibility carries three costs: a biased likelihood approximation with tunable guidance weights, hundreds of neural function evaluations (NFEs), and priors that, even in latent space,
reach billions of parameters ( Podell et al., 2024 ) . Distilled consistency and flow-map models ( Song et al., 2023 ; Luo et al., 2023 ; Boffi et al., 2025 ) cut sampling to a few NFEs, and zero-shot solvers built on distilled latent models now set the state of the art ( Garber & Tirer, 2025 ; Spagnoletti et al., 2025 ; Spagnoletti et al., 2026 ) ,
but the biased likelihood and large prior remain. End-to-end methods instead learn the reconstruction directly, typically with physics-aware unrolled or equilibrium networks ( Monga et al., 2021 ; Gilton et al., 2021 ) trained per operator, often by fine-tuning a pre-trained denoiser, returning point estimates. Conditional diffusion and bridge models sample the posterior ( Liu et al., 2023a ; Zhao et al., 2024 ; Mbakam et al., 2025 ) but are mostly task-specific and as costly as the underlying DM. Since y y is highly informative about 𝒙 \bm{x} , posterior sampling should need far fewer parameters than unconditional generation, yet lightweight networks that generalize across operators remain largely unexplored. A notable exception is the Reconstruct Anything Model (RAM) ( Terris et al., 2026 ) , an
operator-conditioned DRUNet that solves many linear inverse problems with one network, but returns a point estimate of 𝒙 \bm{x} not posterior samples.

blocks.en: We introduce the Bayesian Anything Model (BAM), a lightweight foundation model for few-step, physics-aware posterior sampling that bridges these two camps. BAM is a conditional flow map that transports a Gaussian reference to the posterior p ⁡ ( 𝒙 ∣ y , A , σ y ) p(\bm{x}\mid y,A,\sigma_{y}) , with the instrument physics specified at inference time rather than fixed during training. Pre-trained jointly on large image corpora and libraries of forward operators, a single model draws posterior samples in a few steps, with no likelihood approximation and no guidance weights to tune. Our contributions are as follows: • A flow-map training paradigm. We propose a recipe that upgrades an unfolded reconstruction network into such a flow map, via Lagrangian self-distillation on a normalized stochastic interpolant of the measurement. • A lightweight foundation model. Built on the 36M-parameter RAM backbone, a UNet with unrolled physics-aware updates, BAM learns this map across operators, noise levels and datasets, delivering high-quality posterior samples ( Figure 1 ) and generalizing to new data and tasks. • State-of-the-art quality at a fraction of the cost. On FFHQ, AFHQ, LSUN, DIV2K and the Köhler benchmark, BAM outperforms specialized models and leading zero-shot methods in sample quality in just three steps, advancing the quality–cost Pareto frontier ( Figure 2 ). BAM lowers the barrier to generative computational imaging, cuts the economic and environmental cost of training imaging models, and opens a new direction for physics-aware Bayesian imaging.

BAM is trained on 4KLSDB ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) , bicubically downsampled to 2K resolution, together with HQ-50K ( Yang et al., 2023 ) , DIV2K ( Agustsson & Timofte, 2017 ) , FFHQ-512 ( Karras et al., 2019 ) , and the LSDIR ( Li et al., 2023 ) images above 1K resolution. Starting from the public RAM checkpoint 2 2 2 https://github.com/matthieutrs/ram ,
we train the baseline BAM for 170 170 hours on 8 H100 GPUs, jointly on all inverse problems. These are bicubic SR × 4 \times 4 and × 8 \times 8 , isotropic Gaussian blur with σ blur ∈ [ 1 , 5 ] \sigma_{\text{blur}}\in[1,5] , motion blur with random 61 × 61 61\times 61 kernels of intensity 0.5 0.5 3 3 3 https://github.com/LeviBorodenko/motionblur ; see Appendix E.4 . , compressed sensing at a 25 % 25\% rate, inpainting with 80 % 80\% of pixels masked at random, and demosaicing, all with noise levels σ y ∈ [ 0 , 0.05 ] \sigma_{y}\in[0,0.05] . The fine-tuned variant, BAM ⋆ \star , continues from this baseline for 16 16 hours on 2 H100 GPUs on each target dataset, still across all problems (see appendix C ).

We compare BAM and BAM ⋆ \star with zero-shot methods (LATINO, LATINO-PRO, TReg) and training-based methods (RAM, SILO, UD2M, I 2 SB), described in Appendix A . UD2M and I 2 SB are pixel-space diffusion models limited to lower resolutions, so we evaluate them only on FFHQ-512. SILO, UD2M and I 2 SB use one checkpoint per dataset–problem pair (although UD2M can be trained over operator families), and RAM is evaluated before and after finetuning. All are fine-tuned with their public code, at the evaluated noise levels, for the cumulative runtime of one BAM dataset finetuning, whereas a single BAM model covers all noise levels.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion and limitations
blocks.zh: 5 结论和限制

blocks.en: We introduced BAM, a 36M-parameter physics-aware generative foundation model for Bayesian computational imaging that generalizes robustly to unseen data and tasks, zero-shot or with minimal finetuning. BAM upgrades the operator-conditioned RAM backbone into a conditional flow map or consistency model, pre-trained jointly on large image corpora and libraries of forward operators. The forward operator is an input to the network, so instrument physics is specified at inference time. A single lightweight network then draws posterior samples without likelihood approximations, guidance weights or task-specific retraining. Across linear inverse problems on FFHQ, AFHQ, LSUN, DIV2K and Köhler, BAM outperformed both specialised models and leading zero-shot methods in just 3 3 steps, at a fraction of their computational cost.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了BAM, 一个36M参数的物理学认识基因基础模型, 用于贝叶斯计算成像, 将数据与任务,零镜头或微调都普遍化为看不见。 BAM将操作员有条件的RAM主干线升级为有条件的流图或一致性模型,在大型图像公司和前置操作员库上联合进行预训. 前置操作员是网络的输入,因此仪器物理是在推论时间指定的. 单一的轻量级网络然后抽取后期样本,而不可能进行近似,制导权重或特定任务再培训. 纵观FFHQ,AFHQ,LSUN,DIV2K和Köhler上的线性反向问题,BAM的性能都超过了专门模型和领先的零射法,仅以3个步骤,其计算成本的一小部分.

blocks.en: BAM has four main limitations. It handles only additive Gaussian noise and linear or mildly nonlinear forward operators. It is non-blind, i.e., the instrument model must be supplied, so blind problems rely on an external estimate of the operator. It does not detect model misspecification, so under strong distribution shift it can return unreliable posteriors without warning. Finally, posterior sample quality was assessed empirically, and formal guarantees for the learned conditional flow map remain open.
blocks.zh: BAM有四个主要限制. 它只处理添加剂的高斯噪声和线性或轻度的非线性前进操作器. 它是非盲的,即必须提供仪器模型,因此盲点问题依赖于对操作者的外部估计. 它没有检测到模型的错位,因此在强烈的分布转移下,它可以在不预警的情况下返回不可靠的后部. 最后,对抽样后的质量进行了实证评估,对学到的有条件流动图的正式保证仍然开放。

blocks.en: BAM brings generative Bayesian imaging within reach of the global computational imaging community. The natural next applications are scientific and medical imaging, such as MRI, CT, microscopy and astronomy, where forward operators are known and ground truth is scarce. In these domains, posterior samples support Bayesian decision theory, optimal estimation, uncertainty quantification and experimental design, adding significant value to existing point estimation approaches. On the methodological side, the priorities are formal convergence and accuracy guarantees, non-Gaussian noise models, nonlinear and partially unknown forward models, larger operator libraries, automatic out-of-distribution detection, and more sophisticated backbones. The community can then fine-tune BAM instead of training from scratch, widening access and reducing the economic and environmental cost of deep learning for imaging.
blocks.zh: BAM将基因贝叶斯成像带入全球计算成像界的视野. 接下来的自然应用是科学和医学成像,如核磁共振,CT,显微镜和天文学,前方操作者已知,地面真理稀缺. 在这些领域,后采样支持贝叶斯决策理论,最佳估计,不确定性量化和实验设计,为现有的点估计方法增添了重要价值. 在方法方面,优先事项是正式的趋同和准确的保证,非古西语噪声模型,非线性和部分未知的前进模型,更大的操作员库,自动的分流检测,以及更复杂的骨干. 然后社区可以对BAM进行微调,而不是从零开始培训,扩大获取机会,并降低深入学习成像的经济和环境成本。

blocks.en: Appendix A Compared methods and related restoration models
blocks.zh: 比较方法和相关恢复模型

blocks.en: We describe the methods used in our numerical comparisons and discuss two closely related approaches. The main distinctions concern the reconstruction target, the way the forward operator enters the model, and the computation required at inference time. The experimental adaptation of each baseline follows Section 4 .
blocks.zh: 我们介绍我们在数字比较中采用的方法,并讨论两个密切相关的方法。 主要区别涉及重建目标,前方操作员进入模型的方式,以及推断时需要的计算. 每一基线的试验性调整均遵循第4节。

blocks.en: A.1 Methods used in the numerical comparisons
blocks.zh: A.1 联合国 数字比较所使用的方法

blocks.en: The Reconstruct Anything Model ( Terris et al., 2026 ) is a non-iterative restoration network built on a DRUNet backbone. It incorporates the acquisition model through a proximal initialization and multiscale Krylov subspace modules, which combine learned features with applications of the forward and adjoint operators. Together with noise conditioning, this construction allows one network to address several imaging problems and to adapt to unseen operators. RAM is trained as a point estimator: under a squared-error objective, its population target is the conditional mean 𝔼 [ 𝒙 ∣ 𝒚 , 𝒜 ] {\mathbb{E}}[{\bm{x}}\mid{\bm{y}},\mathcal{A}] . It therefore provides a natural reference for reconstruction accuracy and for the empirical mean of repeated BAM samples. BAM retains this lightweight, physics-aware backbone but learns a conditional flow map with a random source, rather than a deterministic observation-to-image regressor.
blocks.zh: 重建Anything Model(Terris et al., 2026)是一个建立在DRUNet主干线上的非引力修复网络. 它通过近缘初始化和多尺度的Krylov子空间模块将获取模型纳入其中,这些模块将学到的特性与前沿和联合运营商的应用结合起来。 这种构造与噪声调节一起,使一个网络能够解决几个成像问题,并适应看不见的操作员. RAM被训练为点估计器:在一个平方-反射目标下,其人口目标为有条件的平均值 E [x y, A] \ mathbb{E} [{\bm{} mid{\bm{y}},\ mathcal{A}]. 因此,它为重建准确性和重复的BAM样品的经验平均值提供了自然参考。 BAM保留了这种轻量级,物理学意识的骨干,但学习了带有随机源的有条件的流量图,而不是确定性的观测对图像的递减器.

blocks.en: Regularization by Texts (TReg) ( Kim et al., 2025 ) uses a pre-trained text-to-image latent DM (LDM) ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) to resolve ambiguities in inverse problems. Its reverse diffusion procedure alternates data-consistency optimization with latent updates regularized by the text-conditioned clean-image estimate. An adaptive negation mechanism updates the null-text embedding used in classifier-free guidance, suppressing concepts inconsistent with the current reconstruction. The physical operator enters the inference-time optimization rather than the diffusion backbone. TReg thus provides a zero-shot, text-regularized comparison, with iterative diffusion and optimization costs that require hundreds of NFEs.
blocks.zh: 由Texts(TReg)(Kim等人,2025年)进行规范化,使用经过预先训练的文本到图像潜在DM(LDM)(Rombach等人,2022年)来解决反向问题的模糊性. 它的反向传播程序替代了数据一致性优化,潜在更新通过文本条件清洁图像估计规范化. 适应性否定机制更新了无分类指导中使用的空文本嵌入,压制了与当前重建不一致的概念. 物理操作员进入推论-时间优化而不是扩散骨干. TReg因此提供了零镜头,文本规范化的比较,与需要数百个非FE的迭代传播和优化成本.

blocks.en: LAtent consisTency INverse sOlver (LATINO) ( Spagnoletti et al., 2025 ) is a zero-shot PnP inverse solver that uses a pre-trained latent consistency model (LCM) ( Luo et al., 2023 ) as an image prior. Its stochastic autoencoding construction combines a forward noising step with fast generative restoration, and incorporates the measurements through a proximal data-fidelity update in image space. This separates the supplied acquisition model from the learned prior and avoids differentiating through the generative network or the autoencoder for measurement conditioning. The resulting solver requires few neural evaluations, but still alternates a general-purpose latent generator with external data-consistency updates. BAM instead learns the measurement- and operator-conditioned map itself.
blocks.zh: Latent consis Tency enversion sOlver(LATINO)(Spagnoletti等人,2025年)是一个零镜头的PnP反向解析器,它使用预先训练的潜在一致性模型(LCM)(Lo等人,2023年)作为图像前置. 其结构化的自动编码构造将向前点名步骤与快速基因修复相结合,并通过图像空间中的近似数据-真实性更新来纳入测量. 这把所提供的获取模型与以前学到的模型分开,避免通过基因网络或测量条件自动编码器加以区分。 由此产生的解析器不需要多少神经评价,但仍可以替代一个具有外部数据一致性的通用潜在生成器。 BAM转而学习测量和操作的地图本身。

blocks.en: LATINO-PRO ( Spagnoletti et al., 2025 ) extends LATINO by estimating the text conditioning from the observation. It uses an empirical Bayesian formulation that maximizes the marginal likelihood of the measurements with respect to the prompt embedding, alternating prompt updates with stochastic reconstruction. This can correct an incomplete or misleading prompt, at the cost of additional computation for its calibration. We compare both variants to distinguish the contribution of the fast inverse solver from that of adapting the text-conditioned prior.
blocks.zh: LATINO-PRO(Spagnoletti等人,2025年)通过从观察中估计文字条件来扩展LATINO. 它使用一种经验主义的巴耶斯式配方,最大限度地扩大在快速嵌入、交替快速更新和结构重建方面测量的边际可能性。 这可以纠正不完全或误导的迅速情况,其代价是对其校准进行额外计算。 我们比较这两个变体,以区分快速反向解析器与调整前置文本条件的贡献。

blocks.en: The Unfolded and Distilled Diffusion Model (UD2M) ( Mbakam et al., 2025 ) converts a pre-trained diffusion prior into a few-step conditional sampler by unfolding the LATINO Langevin algorithm. Its trainable blocks retain explicit likelihood-dependent proximal updates and stochastic generative steps. A supervised distillation objective, inspired by consistency trajectory models ( Kim et al., 2023 ) and combining distortion, perceptual and adversarial terms, adapts the unfolded network for posterior sampling. Importantly, UD2M supports joint training over families of likelihoods and specialization to the supplied measurement model at inference time. Relative to BAM, its central construction unfolds and distills an existing sampling algorithm, rather than implementing a conditional image flow map with a lightweight restoration backbone.
blocks.zh: 未覆盖和稀释的分散模型(UD2M)(Mbakam等人,2025年)通过LATINO Langevin算法的展开,将事先经过训练的传播转换成几个步骤的有条件取样器。 它的可训练区块保留了明确的可能性依赖的近缘更新和分泌基因步骤. 在一致性轨迹模型(Kim等人,2023年)的启发下,并结合扭曲、感知和对抗等术语,一个有监督的蒸馏目标使所展开的网络适应后采样。 重要的是,UD2M支持对可能性家庭进行联合培训,并在推断时间专门采用所提供的计量模型。 相对于BAM,其中心构造展开并提炼出现有的采样算法,而不是执行带有轻量级恢复主干线的有条件图像流图.

blocks.en: SILO (Solving Inverse Problems with Latent Operators) ( Raphaeli et al., 2025 ) retains a pre-trained LDM prior and learns a surrogate for the degradation in latent space. The surrogate predicts the latent representation of the measurements, allowing likelihood guidance to operate without repeatedly decoding and re-encoding images. Sampling still differentiates through the latent denoiser and learned operator, and requires hundreds of NFEs. SILO is consequently a PnP method with an additional operator-learning stage, rather than a fully zero-shot solver or a directly trained conditional diffusion model. Its measurement conditioning relies on the learned latent surrogate, whereas BAM receives the physical operator through the forward and adjoint actions in its architecture.
blocks.zh: SILO(解决与Latent操作员的逆向问题)(Raphaeli等人,2025年)保留了经过预先培训的LDM前身,并学习了潜伏空间降解的代孕. 代位预测测量的潜在表现,使概率导在操作时无需反复解码和重新编码图像. 取样仍然通过潜在操作员和有学识的操作员加以区分,需要数百个非常规测试。 因此,SILO是一种具有额外操作员学习阶段的PnP方法,而不是一个完全零镜头解答器或直接训练的有条件扩散模型. 其测量条件依赖于学到的潜伏代孕,而BAM则通过其结构中的前置和联合动作接收物理操作员.

blocks.en: I 2 SB (Image-to-Image Schrödinger Bridge) ( Liu et al., 2023a ) learns a diffusion bridge between clean images and their degraded counterparts. Given paired endpoints, its tractable bridge marginals permit simulation-free training, and reconstruction starts from the degraded image rather than unstructured Gaussian noise. This exploits the spatial information already present in the observation and supports stochastic image restoration. In its standard formulation, the degradation is represented by the training pairs and the degraded endpoint; an arbitrary forward operator is not supplied to the network as in BAM. Our comparison therefore contrasts operator-conditioned flow maps with a learned image-to-image diffusion bridge adapted to each evaluated restoration task.
blocks.zh: I 2 SB (Image-to-Image Schrödinger Bridge)(Liu et al., 2023a) 学习清洁图像与退化的对应图像之间的传播桥. 由于成对的终点,其可拉动的桥边可以进行无模拟训练,重建从退化的图像开始,而不是从无结构的高斯噪音开始. 这利用了观测中已经存在的空间信息,并且支持有条理的图像修复. 在标准表述中,退化由培训对子和退化终点所代表;不象BAM那样向网络提供任意的前沿操作员。 因此,我们的比较将操作员条件的流程图与适应每项评估的修复任务的有学识的图像到图像传播桥相比较。

blocks.en: A.2 Related operator-conditioned and flow-map approaches
blocks.zh: A.2 相关的操作者条件和流程图方法

blocks.en: InvFusion ( Elata et al., 2025 ) is a supervised, operator-conditioned diffusion posterior sampler. Its feature degradation layers apply the forward operator and its pseudo-inverse to internal activations and fuse the resulting measurement information through joint attention. Its main benchmarks emphasize strongly underdetermined problems with large null spaces: patch inpainting retains less than 10 % 10\% of the patches, while strided motion blur combines blurring with subsampling. In these settings, substantial image content must be generated in directions unconstrained by the measurements. Our emphasis is on a lightweight sampler across restoration problems where fidelity to the available measurements remains central, including noisy deblurring and demosaicing. Its HDiT backbone, with feature widths reaching 1536 1536 channels, joint-attention blocks, and a reported 63 63 -NFE sampling configuration, also entails a substantially heavier inference procedure than BAM’s 36 36 M-parameter, three-step model. These architectural and sampling differences motivate our focus on compact conditional flow maps.
blocks.zh: InvFusion(Elata等人,2025年)是受监督的操作条件化扩散后取样器. 其特征降解层将前置操作器及其伪反向应用于内部激活,并通过联合注意将由此产生的测量信息引信。 其主要基准强调在大空格下确定性很强的问题:补丁的涂装保留了不到10%的补丁 10\%,而扭曲的运动模糊化结合了模糊化与子样. 在这些设置中,大量的图像内容必须在不受测量限制的方向生成. 我们的重点是一个轻量级的采样器,处理各种修复问题,在这些问题上,忠于现有测量标准仍然至关重要,包括吵闹的破解和降级。 其HDIT主干线,其特征宽度达到1536,1536个通道,联合观察区块,以及所报告的63-NFE采样配置,也比BAM的36,36 M参数三步模型需要大大的推导程序. 这些建筑和抽样差异促使我们把重点放在紧凑的有条件流动图上。

blocks.en: FlowMapSR ( Noble et al., 2026 ) is particularly close to our work in its use of flow maps for few-step restoration. It learns a transport from low-resolution to high-resolution image latents using paired data, and studies Lagrangian, Eulerian and Semigroup formulations, enhanced with perceptual training, positive-negative prompting and adversarial fine-tuning. The distinction is the source of the transport: FlowMapSR starts from the encoded low-resolution image and maps it to a high-resolution reconstruction. For a fixed source latent and guidance configuration, this flow defines a single output; it does not transport independent random inputs into a posterior distribution for that fixed observation. Moreover, the model is not conditioned on a supplied forward operator or noise model, and the same network is used across upscaling factors without degradation-guided mechanisms. Thus, despite the shared flow-map machinery, FlowMapSR addresses perceptual super-resolution through an image-to-image map, rather than operator-conditioned posterior sampling. BAM instead retains a random source while conditioning on the observation and acquisition physics.
blocks.zh: FlowMapSR(Noble et al., 2026)特别接近于我们使用流图进行几步修复的工作. 它利用对等数据,学习从低分辨率到高分辨率图像潜伏的迁移,并研究拉格朗吉亚、欧莱安和半群配方,辅之以知觉训练、正负诱导和对抗微调。 区分是传送源:FlowMapSR从编码的低分辨率图像开始,并将其映射到高分辨率重建. 对于固定源潜在和制导配置,这种流定义了单一输出;它不会将独立的随机输入传输到该固定观测的后置分布. 此外,该模型不以所供应的前置操作器或噪声模型为条件,同一网络被用于没有降解导引机制的升级因素。 因此,尽管有共享的流图机械,FlowMapSR通过图像到图像的映射,而不是操作者有条件的后置采样,处理感知超解. BAM转而保留随机源,同时对观测和获取物理进行条件化.

blocks.en: D.3 Why the contrast loss matters
blocks.zh: D.3 联合国 对比损失为何重要

blocks.en: The contrast term in ( 19 ) is introduced to prevent excessive local and global contrast during mixed-dataset pre-training. Without it, we observe a recurrent tendency toward over-saturated outputs, as illustrated in Figure 11 . This effect is plausibly caused by the heterogeneity of the joint training distribution: the constituent datasets have different image statistics and effective intensity scales, while the different forward operators induce conditioning signals with different dynamic ranges. A one-sided contrast penalty provides a simple way to regularize this scale mismatch without forcing the reconstruction toward a specific global histogram. Consistently with this interpretation, we remove the term during dataset-specific fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 采用(19)中的对照词是为了防止在混合数据集预训期间出现过度的地方和全球对比。 如图11所示,没有这一条,我们就会看到一再出现产出过饱和的趋势。 这种效果由联合训练分布的异质性引起:组成数据集具有不同的图像统计和有效的强度尺度,而不同的前方操作员则诱导具有不同动态范围的调节信号. 片面的对比处罚提供了一种简单的方式,可以规范这种比例不匹配的情况,而不会迫使重建转向特定的全球直方图。 按照这一解释,我们在数据集特定微调时删除该词。

blocks.en: We also tested augmenting the objective with a discriminator loss during FFHQ super-resolution fine-tuning, a common practice also used by Noble et al. (2026) and UD2M ( Mbakam et al., 2025 ) . In particular, we adopt the same discriminator architecture used to train UD2M. Figure 12 shows that the training LPIPS trajectories with and without the adversarial term are nearly indistinguishable over the observed window. In particular, the discriminator does not provide a measurable improvement in the perceptual training criterion used by the final model. We therefore omit adversarial training from the final BAM objective, avoiding the additional discriminator, optimization instability, and computational overhead.
blocks.zh: 我们还试验了在FFHQ超分辨率微调过程中以歧视者损失来增强这一目标,诺贝尔等人(2026年)和UD2M(Mbakam等人,2025年)也采用了这种做法。 特别是,我们采用了同样用于培训UD2M的歧视性建筑. 图12显示,无论有无对抗性术语,LPIPS的训练轨迹在所观察到的窗口上几乎无法区分。 特别是,歧视者无法在最终模式使用的认知培训标准方面提供可衡量的改进。 因此,我们把对抗性训练从BAM最终目标中忽略了,避免了额外的歧视者,优化不稳定性和计算间接费用。

blocks.en:
The discrete JPEG map is nonlinear because of coefficient rounding.
For operator conditioning and the linear solves in the reconstruction network, we replace rounding by the identity.
The DCT and quantization scalings then cancel, leaving the linear color/chroma operator 𝒜 ~ = C YCC → RGB ​ diag ⁡ ( I , U ​ D , U ​ D ) ​ C RGB → YCC , \widetilde{\mathcal{A}}=C_{\mathrm{YCC}\to\mathrm{RGB}}\operatorname{diag}(I,UD,UD)C_{\mathrm{RGB}\to\mathrm{YCC}}, (25) where D D selects one chroma pixel per 2 × 2 2\times 2 block and U U repeats it over that block.
Affine offsets are excluded from this linear operator.
Its true adjoint transposes the color matrices, sums the four repeated chroma contributions, and inserts zeros at unsampled locations; it is not an inverse JPEG decoder.
Thus the observation retains quantization artifacts while the network is conditioned on a rounding-relaxed approximation.
The saved sampler setting σ y = 0.05 \sigma_{y}=0.05 is distinct from the codec’s pre-compression noise level 0.01 0.01 .
blocks.zh:

DCT和定量缩放然后取消, 留下线性颜色/ 色调操作员 A ~ = C YCC → RGB diag → (I, U D, U D) C RGB → YCC ,\glassilde\ mathcal{A}}=C_{\mathrm{YCC}\to\ mathrm{RGB}}\operatorname{diag}(I,UD,UD) C_{\mathrm{RGB}\to\ mathrm{YCC}}, (25) D 选择一个chromaixel 每2\2\tims 2 block, U 重复该块.
此线性运算符中不包括折合。
其真实的副电联转录颜色矩阵,将四次重复的染色体贡献相加,并在无样本位置插入零;它不是一个反的JPEG解码器.
因此,观察保留了数量化文物,而网络则以四舍五入的近似为条件。

blocks.en: Appendix F Robustness to Int8 quantization
blocks.zh: 附录F 强性到 Int8 的量化

blocks.en: In this section, we evaluate the robustness and computational efficiency of BAM under INT8 quantization for TensorRT deployment. To achieve this, we convert the model from floating-point execution to INT8 where supported. In contrast, we retained higher-precision operations that are sensitive to reduced precision or are not efficiently supported in INT8. All experiments are performed on 512 × 512 512\times 512 images using an NVIDIA A40 GPU.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们评价在INT8量化下为TensorRT部署的BAM的稳健性和计算效率. 为了实现这一点,我们将模型从浮点执行转换为支持的INT8. 相比之下,我们保留了对降低精度敏感或者在INT8中没有得到高效支持的更高精度操作. 所有实验均使用NVIDIA A40 GPU在512×512 512\times 512影像上进行.

blocks.en: The optimization combines INT8 quantization with a more efficient implementation of the physics-aware operations. Profiling revealed that operations within the PhysicsBlock , particularly convolution and transposed-convolution layers, accounted for a substantial fraction of the overall inference latency. These operations were therefore reformulated to reduce redundant computation and improve their execution under TensorRT.
blocks.zh: 优化结合INT8量化与更高效地实施物理感知操作. 分析表明,物理舱内的操作,特别是演化层和移位演化层,占整个推论延迟的很大一部分。 因此,重新调整了这些行动,以减少重复计算,改进在TensorRT下的执行工作。

blocks.en: In Table 11 , we compare the end-to-end performance before and after quantization. The baseline model requires 280.56 280.56 ms per inference, whereas the INT8-optimized model reduces the latency to 79.91 79.91 ms. This corresponds to a 3.51 × 3.51\times end-to-end speedup and a 71.5 % 71.5\% reduction in inference latency. This reduction in latency is directly reflected in the inference throughput, which increases from 3.56 3.56 to 12.51 12.51 queries per second (qps). This represents an absolute gain of 8.95 8.95 qps. The acceleration comes with a moderate degradation in reconstruction quality, with PSNR decreasing from 22.49 22.49 to 21.20 21.20 dB, SSIM from 0.570 0.570 to 0.498 0.498 , and LPIPS increasing from 0.400 0.400 to 0.427 0.427 . In Figure 25 , we present qualitative results from both models, showing that the INT8-optimized model preserves reconstruction quality comparable to the baseline despite the substantial reduction in inference cost.

blocks.en: These results demonstrate that BAM can be efficiently deployed under INT8 quantization. More importantly, the gains arise from combining reduced-precision inference with a TensorRT-friendly reformulation of the physics-aware computations, resulting in substantially lower latency and higher throughput. These results are obtained without fine-tuning. Quantization-aware fine-tuning could further improve performance in the quantized regime and is left for future work.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,BAM可以在INT8量化下有效部署. 更重要的是,将降低精度的推论与对物理学认识的计算进行方便的TensorRT重订相结合,使延迟率和吞吐量大大降低。 这些结果是在没有微调的情况下取得的。 量化-意识微调可进一步提高量化制度中的绩效,留待今后工作.
